description: Fingerprints of the tested Windows x86 PD2/D2GL files and plugin, with activation and loader settings.
validation: All three Win32 Release suites passed with private artwork/table/archive fixtures. The user confirmed shrine/event icons work in the installed build on 2026-09-12; live logs accepted marker definitions and recorded fallback submissions and native duplicate skips. Ships that exact tested DLL. The hardcoded 31-subtile radius and existing appearance settings remain unchanged. Broader compatibility and long-session performance remain under test; this is not online approval or anti-tamper enforcement.
gameTables: Automatically read from active installed game archives or direct overrides via native Storm; development fixture hashes are informational, not files to download. Missing/malformed geometry or layer tables retain native/per-area fallback. Missing marker definitions disable the affected shrine/event fallback; existing native drawing remains.
optionalMenuNote: The native Boundary Color menu row requires the profiled expansion menu. A different menu layout leaves INI color selection available; this optional fingerprint does not replace runtime layout guards.
